title: MadaRWA
tagline: Layer 3 Chain tailored for tokenizing real-world assets (RWAs), featuring wallet tiers based on KYC and KYB compliance. The chain includes a token standard for regulatory adherence.
description: The project aims to develop a Layer 3 chain specifically designed for the tokenization of real-world assets (RWAs). This platform will feature differentiated wallet tiers that vary based on the KYC (Know Your Customer) and KYB (Know Your Business) compliance status of users. It will also introduce a token standard designed to handle the requirements of RWA tokenization in compliance with potential regulations.
how_its_made: We are using Madara to have a configurable chain which we can use our Cairo contracts, we are using general Cairo tools like openZeppelin contracts or rustup and scarab for rust & cairo. We needed specific configuration for our permissioned chain while using cairo contracts and AA of starknet, we will be using one of the scaffolds for stark and one of the wallet but we are not planning on any of the partner rewards for now.
